prior_negative_evidence.v33_final_only_cakes: Rejected because a final-logit residual could not write capability information into persistent transformer state on the then-weak parent.
prior_negative_evidence.v37_shared_deep_adapters: Rejected before full training because fourteen installed rank-32 adapters plus an internal router exceeded the locked RSS gate by 897024 bytes.
why_not_a_repeat: V463 is a strong 1303/1400 zero-collapse parent, not an acquisition-from-weak-parent model.
Only four measured weak capabilities activate correction; ten strong routes are an explicit bit-exact bypass.
One rank-64 nonlinear residual is shared across all three blocks instead of installing fourteen complete adapters.
The already three-seed-qualified V45/V46 router is reused unchanged rather than training another embedded router.
The bridge is a separately hashed ABI host artifact and the sealed V463 checkpoint remains immutable.

decision: Preregister exactly one seed, rate, step count, rank, loss, and four-capability scope. Require strict V1 gates, zero V2 collapse, exact qualified routing, and byte-exact V463 outputs on every strong-capability prompt before replication or runtime work. Any miss closes this architecture without a nearby sweep.
claim_boundary: Design and evidence review only; no quality, speed, memory, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
